name: CLITE
recent: Chemlite Innovation Berhad 近期发布了截至2025年6月30日和2025年9月30日的季度业绩。此外，公司在2026年8月29日和2026年9月9日分别发布了「OTHERS」类别公告，但公告内文未提供具体细节。
notable: 公司发布了截至2025年6月30日的季度业绩，营收环比增长11.4%至939.2万令吉，但净利润环比下降50.9%至51.8万令吉。
公司发布了截至2025年9月30日的季度业绩。
risks: 净利润环比下降50.9%，净利率从12.5%降至5.5%。
earnings: 截至2025年6月30日的季度，营收为939.2万令吉，环比增长11.4%，同比增长5.5%；净利润为51.8万令吉，环比下降50.9%，同比下降36.9%；净利率为5.5%，低于上一季度的12.5%。

recent_en: Chemlite Innovation Berhad recently released quarterly results for the periods ended 30 June 2025 and 30 September 2025. The company also issued 'OTHERS' announcements on 29 August 2026 and 9 September 2026, but no details were provided in the announcement text.
notable_en: The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2025, with revenue up 11.4% QoQ to MYR 9.392 million but net income down 50.9% QoQ to MYR 0.518 million.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2025.
risks_en: Net income declined 50.9% QoQ, with net margin falling from 12.5% to 5.5%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2025, revenue was MYR 9.392 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 5.5% YoY; net income was MYR 0.518 million, down 50.9% QoQ and 36.9% YoY; net margin was 5.5%, lower than 12.5% in the previous quarter.
